text:
jane_sales: Procurement at Solstice wants to break the order into two POs (US entity + EU entity) but keep a single MSA. They also want: net45, two signers (legal + finance), and SOC2 attestation attached to the order. Legal already sent redlines on indemnity/limitation. Can someone confirm e-sign path and billing flow? @anna_legal @tom_se

 tom_se: Do we have the redline diff? quick ask: is the MSA already countersigned or is this pre-sign?

 jane_sales: Pre-sign. Pasted excerpt from procurement email: "we need separate invoices per legal entity, wire instructions per invoice, and both signatures on the order form. Also attach SOC2 report or link to audit portal."

 anna_legal: Ok. For signature routing we can do ordered signing in DocuSign: signer1 = Solstice finance, signer2 = Solstice legal, signer3 = Redwood authorized sig (exec). We can include the MSA by reference on the order form and add a countersign block. On indemnity redline: propose compromise to limit to direct damages and carve out gross negligence. I'll draft an addendum.

 priya_ops: For billing, we'll need two billing accounts created (one per entity) and link each PO to its billing account. If they insist on a single wire to cover both, procurement must supply remittance mapping so we can route funds — ops prefers separate wires per invoice. If they need a single wire, we can accept but need clear remittance codes and GL mapping.

 ryan_se: For the POC SKU, confirm whether they expect hosted or dedicated. If dedicated, usage/seat allocation needs to be split per entity to reflect cost center. Also flag: net45 may block provisioning until finance completes billing account setup.

 jane_sales: Timeline: procurement wants countersigned within 10 business days. Can legal turn around the addendum + signature routing config in 48h? Also need to know if we can attach SOC2 report publicly or send via secure link.

 anna_legal: I can draft addendum today and jump on a quick call with procurement if needed. SOC2: we can share read-only audit portal link (preferred) or attach the latest report under an NDA. I recommend portal link.

 tom_se: To set the e-sign path in the console: go to Orders -> Order Forms -> open draft -> Signers -> Add signer (email) -> Set order = 1,2,3 -> Enable "require all signers". For DocuSign envelopes we'll tag the order form with contract_id and PO refs. Example snippet: `orders.createEnvelope(order_id, {signers: ["solstice_finance@...","solstice_legal@...","redwood_exec@..."]})`

 sign-bot: DocuSign envelope template created: template_id tpl_8a9f. Use `tpl_8a9f` for multi-signer EU/US flows.

 priya_ops: I'll start creating the two billing accounts and ping finance for remittance mapping. Jane, please send procurement the portal link option and ask if they prefer separate wires.

 jane_sales: Thanks — I'll confirm with procurement and post the redline PDF here when I have it.

 tom_se: Great. Tag me when redline posted and I'll pre-config the envelope template for the PO reference. :thumbsup:
